response.explanation_markdown:
On 24 July 2026, satellite observations recorded thermal activity consistent with active burning across the selected area [5]. Timeline data shows local satellite detections appearing between late July and early August 2026 [5].

Regional emergency reports identify a plausible candidate incident in this sector: the Sierra Oeste wildfire, managed from an advanced command post in Cenicientos [W1] [W2]. Official reports attribute the severity of the emergency to high temperatures, strong winds, and the confluence of three distinct fires that merged and behaved as one, leading to evacuations across the Valle del Tiétar and near San Martín de Valdeiglesias and Pelayos de la Presa [W1] [W2] [W3]. A specific ignition cause is absent from the retrieved articles, and available records do not verify that the selected hexagons correspond directly to the perimeter of that named incident [W1].

### Satellite observations

The local FIRMS archive contains **1,232 satellite detections** in the **Selected area at 40.355°, -4.514°** for **2026-07-24** (Aqua, N20, N21, SNPP, Terra). [5]
